findings.text: The status file assumes that `Shared/Execution/PossibleResults` defines "the comparators and the sort used for unordered output", but `stableSort` and `insertStable` are defined in `Shared/Execution/QueryEval.lean`; `PossibleResults.lean` only defines `compareNormal`, `compareRows` and `normalForm`, which calls `stableSort`. Fix: say that `Shared/Execution/PossibleResults` defines the comparators and `normalForm`, and that `Shared/Execution/QueryEval` defines `stableSort`.
